evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3/4 to 1 percent
The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant gradual increases in the federal funds rate
The Committee views the slowing in growth during the first quarter as likely to be transitory
Excluding energy and food, consumer prices declined in March and inflation continued to run somewhat below 2 percent.
Near-term risks to the economic outlook appear roughly balanced.
it anticipates doing so until normalization of the level of the federal funds rate is well under way
